national_news.title: Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 has been passed by Parliament.
The Bill aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The legislation allows the Corporation to undertake activities in industrial goods and provides funding to entities engaged in co-operative development.

national_news.title: Parliament passes Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026 to change state name to Keralam
bullets: The Kerala (Alteration of Name) Bill, 2026, was passed by the Lok Sabha yesterday and the Rajya Sabha today.
The Bill seeks to change the name of the state of Kerala to Keralam in the First Schedule of the Constitution.
The Kerala Legislative Assembly had passed a resolution in 2024, requesting the Centre to change the name of the State from Kerala to Keralam.

national_news.title: Lok Sabha refers FCRA Bill to JPC for further scrutiny
bullets: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026, aims to make the use of foreign contributions more transparent and accountable.
The Bill was referred to the Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) for wider consultations.
The JPC will consist of 21 members from the Lok Sabha, nominated by the Speaker.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy: FM Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies are among the major engines of global growth.
Public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, not a substitute.
Maintaining stability and providing a predictable environment is crucial for attracting private capital.

national_news.title: DoT selects three Sanchar Mitras as envoys of ITU
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications has selected three Sanchar Mitras from India as Generation Connect Youth Envoys (GCYE) of the International Telecommunication Union (ITU).

The programme provides young people with opportunities to contribute to national, regional and global discussions and initiatives related to Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs), digital transformation and inclusive digital development.
The initiative aligns closely with the objectives of the Sanchar Mitra Scheme, which seeks to engage youth in promoting digital literacy and inclusion.

national_news.title: Thailand's Education Ministry to elevate school safety after mass shooting
bullets: Thailand's cabinet has approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically, protecting children, teachers, and education personnel nationwide.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for the protection of rights, liberties, and safety on their premises.

national_news.title: Canadian Open Tennis: Men’s and women’s semifinals locked in
bullets: Iga Swiatek of Poland will face Elina Svitolina of Ukraine in the women's singles semifinals.
Elena Rybakina will meet Coco Gauff in the other women's singles semifinal.
The semifinals will take place in Toronto tomorrow morning.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze medal in the Commonwealth Fencing Championship.
The championship was held in Lagos, Nigeria.
India's overall combined medal count reached 29, comprising 8 Gold, 7 Silver, and 14 Bronze.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI's recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: Sports Ministry suspended TTFI's recognition due to governance deficiencies.
TTFI failed to conduct elections on time, prompting the Ministry's action.
IOA to form an ad-hoc committee to administer the sport in consultation with ITTF.

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa secured his first victory in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, with the Sinquefield Cup being the penultimate event.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, eventually turning the endgame in his favor.

national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% on an annual basis in July.
Inflation remained above the Reserve Bank of India's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the moderate increase in inflation.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College Site in Gopalganj, Gives Directions
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj.
The CM performed puja and aradhana at Thawe Temple, praying for the state's prosperity, peace, and happiness.
The CM's visit is aimed at boosting development and infrastructure in the region.
